title: カレン的SNSとの付き合い方♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "At lunch with City. ♪ #BeautifulCity #and #CuteCurrenChan"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And there's my post. ♪ I'm sure it'll get a ton of likes. ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Geez, Curren. You're too good at getting people to do whatever you want. Before I knew it, we were already at lunch taking a pic together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But I just wanted to spend time with you. Did you not wanna spend time with me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh… There you go again.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You've already got 50,000 likes?! That's insane.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're looking at it? There's a bunch of comments too. It's all thanks to you, City. ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're not kidding. The comments keep on coming… "Cute." "Pretty." "Two beauties…"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What the—?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: What's up?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's nothing…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: No, really! What is it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Normies shouldn't get involved with City." "Nobodies should know their place." …Oh my.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, here come the hate comments… I figured there'd be a few, haha.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But they're using my name to put you down. That's so not the vibe. I better put a stop to this!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's okay. I don't let things like this get to me…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh… But now that I think about it, I've noticed juuust a tad more hate comments since I started at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, seriously?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I've gotten more followers too, but the comments aren't really a safe space anymore… Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Big Bro. How would you handle it?
choice_data_list: I'd show them the light with your cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Big Sis. How would you handle it?
choice_data_list: I'd show them the light with your cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Yeah, you're right. That's what I'd do too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean? I don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. It just means my bond with Big Bro is just that special. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. It just means my bond with Big Sis is just that special. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aaanyway! I wanna ask for your help too, City! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Uh, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: City! You're here! Thanks for yesterday! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …I was just looking at your Umastagram. I finally get what you meant by "showing them the light with your cuteness."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha, you do, huh? Well, it's all thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the whole new way of taking pictures that you taught me, my comments section has gotten safer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After their conversation, Curren Chan posted a picture with new levels of cuteness. When people saw that her cuteness had reached new heights, they changed their tune.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: This one says, "She's not a normie—she's an angel! She's so cute!" What a bunch of perfect hypocrites.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't put it like that. They just saw the light, that's all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I got more followers too. ♪ Let me know if you ever need my help with anything, City!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Not just anyone can do this. You really do amaze me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City stares at Curren Chan with awe in her eyes, and I know exactly how she feels.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose that is the typical solution… You're not mad, are you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well, I suppose that is the typical solution… You're not mad, are you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if she says she's fine, I can't just stand by and let people hurt my trainee. I tell her I think she should take care of the problem right away.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I agree. Nothing good comes from ignoring stuff like this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You should report it to Umastagram. It might take some time, but I'm sure they'll do something.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks, you two. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: But I've got a feeling about this, so please just bear with me for a bit. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm glad things worked out… but I never expected you to have your followers handle it for you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I didn't have them do anything! They just did what they thought was right! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fans who saw the hate comments fought back with comments about Curren's cuteness, and the haters deleted their nasty comments.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I was surprised they ended up following me, though. It's all thanks my fans. ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But there's definitely a fine line. If your fans lash back at the hate comments, everyone will go after them too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That won't happen.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: After all, anyone who likes me wouldn't do anything that's not cute! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …I get it. It sounds like you have a good relationship with your fans.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I think I'll go check my comments too. Maybe I should try liking things my followers post sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Big Bro? You don't think I did the right thing, do you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Big Sis? You don't think I did the right thing, do you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sorry to worry you, but everything worked out, didn't it? Besides…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Seeing you get mad on my behalf was sooo cool. Thank you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Seeing you get mad on my behalf was sooo cool. Thank you. ♪
